tooltip.mobutilities.container.release_h: Sneak-right-click to release the stored mob.
tooltip.mobutilities.container.capture_h: Use on a mob to capture its data.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.matter.1: Obtained by processing a filled mob container in the resolver.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.matter.2: Used in the blood energy generator or the regenerator.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.spirit.1: Obtained by processing a filled mob container in the resolver.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.spirit.2: Used in the soul energy generator or the regenerator.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.experience.1: Obtained by processing a filled mob container in the resolver.
tooltip.mobutilities.item.experience.2: Used in the mob farm together with FE to simulate drops.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.resolver.1: Processes filled mob containers using fuel.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.resolver.2: Outputs matter, spirit, experience, and an empty mob container.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.blood_energ: Consumes matter to generate FE over time.
Accepts speed upgrades and pushes FE to adjacent blocks.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.soul_energy: Consumes spirit to generate FE over time.
Accepts speed upgrades and pushes FE to adjacent blocks.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.mob_farm.1: Consumes FE and experience to simulate loot from the stored mob.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.mob_farm.2: Supports speed, simulation, looting, and special upgrades.
tooltip.mobutilities.machine.regenerator: Consumes an empty container, matter, spirit, and FE to create a random mob.
Writes the result into a new mob container.
